Native Windows desktop automation library and MCP service.

This core package includes UI Automation, window capture, window-bound input,
verified forms and checked batches. It has no model weights or model runtime DLLs.

Requires Windows x64 and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Runtime.
Extract the ZIP and configure the MCP client to run `bin/desktop-pilot.exe serve`
in the target application's interactive desktop. See the included README and docs.

SHA256SUMS.txt verifies the ZIP. Optional icon detection and OCR can be built from
source. See CHANGELOG.md for changes and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for licensing.
